newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai opens China's biggest sealant firm.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai opens China's biggest sealant firm.

text.p: China's largest sealant plant, a Sino-Italian joint venture called Shanghai Shenya Seal Equipment Co Ltd, has begun operation in Shanghai, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.

The company, a joint venture of Shanghai Auto Co Ltd, rubber components maker Italy's SpA Industria Articoli in Gomma (Saiag) Co and Shanghai Yongying Industry Co, has annual capacity of 330,000 sealant strips for use in car production, the agency said.
The company has a total investment of $36 million and is using advanced technology from Italy and Britain, it said.
Company officials were not immediately available to comment.
